name: Starsector Marines - Simplified Chinese
author: Dillon
description: Simplified Chinese copy for Starsector Marines. Partial: the opening tutorials, mission board, briefing, muster, results, debrief, battle UI and mission objectives are translated; other text stays in English. Carries Noto Sans SC faces (SIL OFL 1.1) for the game's fonts, baked by the mod's font generator.
